content_of_post_to_answer: How can one stop overthinking and achieve peace of mind while dealing with failure?
answer: Overthinking after failure often comes from treating a setback as a verdict on your identity instead of feedback on a specific attempt. Peace comes when you separate “I failed” from “I am a failure.” The mind becomes quieter when it has a problem to solve rather than a self to defend. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my Quora profile for anyone who wants to look deeper. Failure hurts most when we turn an event into a definition.
